name: schema-versions
title: The schema versions Dove writes and the ones it accepts
description: Dove writes a schemaVersion into the state files it owns - the workspace policy, the convergence record, the managed install state - and checks a version when it reads them. Both sides live in this repository, so a writer and a reader that disagree is a self-inflicted break that only a user meets. Measure every written version against every accepted one
